name: The Mnemonic Cyst
visual_description: A coiled, tentacled mass with repeating spiral sigils etched into every surface. Its texture shimmers like wet glass over memory tissue.
meaning: An anchor of forgotten thought, decayed and self-repeating.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh seeded these across the ruins.** They were memory caches—fragments of extinct civilizations encoded in fractal nerves. I touched one and remembered a lullaby I never heard. Who sang it? Who missed me?
